# Enterprise Analytics Dashboard  
A cloud-native platform for real-time business intelligence, built with agile practices to scale across 15+ stakeholders. Reduces query latency by 30% through optimized data pipelines and dynamic visualization layers.  

## Deployment  
Continuous delivery via AWS CodePipeline with blue-green deployment. 99.95% SLA achieved through auto-scaling and zero-downtime rollouts. Monitors 200+ metrics across 12 environments.

## Tech Stack  
- Cloud: AWS (Lambda, DynamoDB, CloudFront)  
- Data: Apache Kafka (stream processing), PostgreSQL (OLAP)  
- Frontend: React 18.2, Chart.js (custom visualization layer)  
- CI/CD: GitHub Actions, Terraform (infrastructure as code)  
- Analytics: Mixpanel (A/B testing), SQL Server 2019 (batch processing)  

## Architecture / Design  
Microservices-driven with API Gateway as the single entry point. Data pipelines split into ingestion (Kafka), transformation (Spark), and storage (S3/Redshift). Visualization layer decouples front-end from backend, enabling 40% faster query rendering.  

## Getting Started / Installation  
```bash  
git clone https://github.com/enterprise-analytics/dashboard.git  
cd dashboard  
npm install  
export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID="your_key"  
npm run build  
```  
Requires Docker 20.10+ and Node.js 18.  

## Usage / Examples  
**Real-time dashboard**:  
```bash  
npm run start:prod  
# Access via https://dashboard.enterprise.com  
```  
**A/B testing**:  
```bash  
npm run ab-test -- --variant=gold --metric=conversion  
```  
Monitors 15+ KPIs with 95% confidence intervals.
